blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `validateStoreCreditAccountStep`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

This step validates that all gift cards on the cart have a positive balance.
It throws an error for any gift card with zero or negative balance.
